zh: 从这个一般框架直接得出关于理论物理学本性的两个结论。在理论物理学的框架内：

en: (a) Relations are conceptually prior to objects. (b) Objectivity has nothing to do with the existence of objects independent from our thought.
zh: （a）关系在概念上先于对象。（b）客观性与独立于我们思维的对象的存在毫无关系。

en: The objects of the theory emerge from the interplay of the laws and the principles of the theory itself because they express the kind of constant pattern that ties together the empirical features that in different ways we consider properties of the object or consequences of the dynamics that the theory ascribes to its objects. In this sense, a working theory “generates” its own objects, and their objectivity is grounded in the very ground of the universality of laws and principles: the universal logical validity of mathematics.
zh: 理论的对象从理论本身的定律与原理的相互作用中涌现，因为这些定律和原理表达恒常模式，把经验特征联结在一起——我们以不同方式把这些特征看作对象的性质，或看作理论归于其对象的动力学的后果。在这个意义上，一个运转中的理论“生成”它自己的对象，而它们的客观性奠基于定律与原理之普遍性的根据本身：数学的普遍逻辑有效性。

en: As we have shown above, Cassirer’ diagnosis about the nature of the conceptual challenge represented by quantum mechanics conforms to these principles. Quantum mechanics does not question the ideal of a nature ordered according to accessible laws and principles; rather, it presents us with a profoundly different picture of these items. In particular quantum objects appear to lack individuality as a consequence of the laws and the principles of the framework. Nonetheless this framework provides us with perfectly objective knowledge of quantum phenomena. Put in different terms, any understanding of phenomena that involves the adoption of the principles of quantum mechanics will lead us to ascribe individuality to the items of the theory only in a problematic sense.
zh: 如我们上面表明的，卡西尔关于量子力学所代表的概念挑战之本性的诊断，符合这些论旨。量子力学并不质疑自然按可通达的定律与原理有序化这一理想；相反，它向我们呈现了这些要素的一幅深刻不同的图景。特别地，量子对象显得缺乏个体性，这是框架的定律与原理的后果。尽管如此，这个框架仍为我们提供关于量子现象的完全客观的知识。换种说法，任何涉及采纳量子力学原理的现象理解，都只会引导我们在成问题的意义上把个体性归于理论的要素。

en: Notice that Cassirer tends to stick with the view of individuality that is traditionally endorsed by Born and the standard interpretation. Recent accounts have questioned the force of arguments against the individuality of quantum objects based on the structure of the theory (see French and Krause, 2006) which indicate that the status of individuality in quantum physics is far more problematic than it appears in the standard interpretation. Nevertheless, as these accounts are based on a thorough conceptual analysis of the fundamental principles of the theory, their implication for any interpretation can be seen as independently refining the results of Cassirer’s reading rather than questioning his basic framework. Most importantly, these more recent accounts can be seen as agreeing with conclusion a) at least when it comes to the quantum domain.
zh: 请注意，卡西尔倾向于坚持玻恩与标准解释传统上认可的个体性观点。晚近的说明已经质疑了基于理论结构反对量子对象个体性的论证的力度（见 French and Krause, 2006），这些说明表明，个体性在量子物理中的地位远比标准解释中呈现的更成问题。尽管如此，由于这些说明基于对理论基本原理的彻底概念分析，它们对任何解释的蕴涵都可以被看作独立地精炼卡西尔解读的结果，而不是质疑他的基本框架。最重要的是，这些较晚近的说明可以被看作至少在量子领域中同意结论（a）。

en: This might sound like an attempt to suggest that that the debate on structuralism should move in a Kantian direction. It is our contention that the peculiarities of Cassirer’s picture and the similarities between his account and the terms of the contemporary debate are such that Neo-Kantianism could be viewed as a relevant option. However, Cassirer’s account in our view presents elements of interest in a more general sense for the structuralist agenda.
zh: 这听起来可能像是试图暗示结构主义争论应当朝康德主义方向移动。我们的主张是：卡西尔图景的独特性，以及他的说明与当代争论所用框架之间的相似性，使得新康德主义可以被看作一个相关的选项。然而在我们看来，卡西尔的说明在更一般的意义上对结构主义议程也包含有趣的要素。

en: First of all, Cassirer’s conclusions about quantum mechanics are not a consequence of his Neo-Kantianism. All that is needed to conclude that quantum objects are not individuals are assumptions 1–3. The only remaining commitment is to a notion of law compatible with idea of functional coordination, but in Cassirer’s work there are no elements that lead to the conclusion that the Neo-Kantian notion of law is the only possible candidate although it is certainly a very natural one, conceptually speaking.
zh: 首先，卡西尔关于量子力学的结论并不是他的新康德主义的后果。要得出量子对象不是个体的结论，所需要的只是假设1–3。唯一剩下的承诺是接受一个与功能性协调观念相容的定律概念，但在卡西尔的著作中没有任何要素导向这样的结论：新康德主义的定律概念是唯一可能的候选者——尽管从概念上说它无疑是一个非常自然的候选者。

en: This allows us to look at Cassirer’s other tenets from a different perspective. In our view, if the relational notions of laws and principles can be detached from the neo-kantian background, there are interesting consequences for the idea of objectivity. From the transcendental idealist standpoint this notion is profoundly linked with the universality of laws and results in particular from the logical nature of mathematics. The objects that a naïve realist reading of the theory would like to postulate as independent from the theory itself are simply independent from the mind setup of a particular human as such. They are not beyond the representation provided by the theory. Rather the representation itself as a piece of objective scientific work is invariant for representation users as it would be if they were “out there”.
zh: 这使我们能够从另一个视角看待卡西尔的其他论旨。在我们看来，如果定律与原理的关系性概念能够脱离新康德主义背景，就会对客观性观念产生有趣的后果。从先验观念论观点看，这个概念与定律的普遍性深刻相连，尤其产生于数学的逻辑本性。对理论的朴素实在论解读想要设定为独立于理论本身的对象，其实只是独立于某个特定人类个体的心智设置。它们并不超出理论提供的表象。相反，表象本身作为一项客观的科学工作，对于使用这一表象的人，表象本身保持不变，就像这些对象真的“在外面”一样。

en: The adoption of a different understanding of the laws may lead to a view of objectivity closer to the classical realist ideal of a mind independent reality to which knowledge gives us access but linked to the fundamentally relational nature of our knowledge.
zh: 采纳对定律的不同理解，可能导向一种更接近经典实在论理想的客观性观——知识使我们通达独立于心灵的实在——但同时与我们知识的根本关系性本性相联系。

en: More generally we take all of the above points to suggest that a crucial aspect of Cassirer’s lesson has to do with the role that an account of the laws of nature should play in the debate on structuralism.
zh: 更一般地，我们认为上述各点都表明：卡西尔教益的一个关键方面，关涉对自然定律的说明应当在结构主义争论中扮演的角色。

en: This is particularly evident in Cassirer (1907), where he responds to logicist criticisms of the Kantian idea of synthetic a priori. Cassirer claims that the logical and thus analytical nature of mathematics does not compromise the fundamental Kantian idea of the a priori synthesis of the understanding. Mathematics is in fact synthetic when considered in its role in ordering the manifold of perceptual experience in theoretical natural science.(see Friedman, 2000).
zh: 这在 Cassirer (1907) 中尤为明显，他在其中回应了逻辑主义对康德先天综合观念的批评。卡西尔主张，数学的逻辑的从而分析的本性，并不损害知性之先天综合这一根本的康德观念。事实上，就数学在理论自然科学中整理知觉经验杂多的作用而言，它是综合的（见 Friedman, 2000）。

en: This is, also, the core of Kant’s explanation of the mathematical nature of Physics since the schematization of categories in the pure intuition of time determines the conditions of possibility of arithmetic and the schematization of categories in the pure intuition of space to geometry.
zh: 这也是康德说明物理学之数学本性的核心，因为范畴在时间纯直观中的图型化规定了算术的可能性条件，范畴在空间纯直观中的图型化则规定了几何学的可能性条件。

en: Ryckman (Ryckman, 1991) explores the extent to which the notion of coordination was in the early twentieth century the focus of a wide variety of analyses of science and identifies in it a further element of commonality between Neo-Kantianism and Logical Empiricism.
zh: 赖克曼（Ryckman, 1991）探究了协调概念在二十世纪初在多大程度上成为各式各样的科学分析的焦点，并在其中识别出新康德主义与逻辑经验论之间的又一个共同要素。
